description: This source file defines multiple React functional components that render SVG icons: EyeIcon, SunIcon, and MoonIcon. These components are intended for UI elements representing visibility, light theme, and dark theme, respectively. Each icon component accepts props for styling and attributes, and is exported for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: EyeIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders an eye-shaped SVG icon, typically used to indicate visibility or view count.

methods.name: SunIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a sun-shaped SVG icon, commonly used to represent a light or day mode.

methods.name: MoonIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a moon-shaped SVG icon, indicative of dark or night mode.
